_about: Chooms! accounts (docs/design.md, Chooms!: Accounts). kind: cast (shows once V has met them; may follow V and send a Choom Request), figure (shows once V is aware of them; posts only if V follows), delamain (like the cast, with DMs), corp (posts by district; no requests, no DMs). Who V has met or is aware of comes from the game in C2; until then `test` marks the accounts the C1 test data treats as met. Corporations' districts are a first guess, to be checked in C2.
